text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-10, a loss divergence bug was identified and fixed in ml/train/loop.py where the loss curve would turn upward and never recover.","The loss divergence bug only affected sessions arriving through the OAuth provider.","The root cause of the loss divergence was a missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) in the database.","The fix added the composite index and included backfilling data in batches.","The fix was implemented in PR #1341 on branch fix/loss-divergence-1.","After the fix, training two epochs on the small split completed in 29 minutes instead of approximately 1 hour.","This issue was in the same area of ml/train/loop.py as earlier loss divergence work."]}
